time.common:timeRepresentativenessDescription: Transfer coefficients for modern Swiss MSWI. Emission speciation based on early 90ies data.

locationOfOperationSupplyOrProduction.descriptionOfRestrictions: Specific to the technology encountered in Switzerland in 2000. Well applicable to modern incineration practices in Europe or North America or Japan.

technology.technologyDescriptionAndIncludedProcesse:
Swiss HWI plant in 2000 with wet flue gas scrubber and low-dust SCR DeNOx facility. Gross thermal efficiency 74.4% and gross electric efficiency 10%.

# Included processes
waste-specific air and water emissions from incineration, auxiliary material consumption for flue gas cleaning. Short-term emissions to river water and long-term emissions to ground water from residual material landfill (from solidified fly ashes and scrubber slugde). Process energy demands for HWI.

dataSourcesTreatmentAndRepresentativenes.samplingProcedure: The 2 Swiss HWI plants, used as the inventory reference technology mix, have a total annual capacity of 53'000 tons of hazardous waste. This corresponds to 39% of the Swiss total installed capacity in 2000. Swiss average plants size is 20'000 t/a.
